subject: Menu-page negative cache and idle discovery backoff
authorized_by: Owner: unbounded performance objective; preserve gameplay and unrelated concurrent work.

final_design.note: A proposed standalone wrapper was discarded; miss caching and backoff are inline in the shared game-context getter.
final_design.implementation: After the existing 1000 ms positive-cache fast path, failed discovery suppresses rescans for a non-sliding 250 ms window. At 4 consecutive signal-less misses it backs off to 1000 ms, reusing _OPEN_FRONT_CONTEXT_REFRESH_MS. A start signal (body.in-game, supported /live/ game routes, visible starting modal) or successful discovery resets the streak. Positive-cache behavior and runtimeState writes are unchanged; active in-game signals prevent backoff.

companion_split.summary: The pre-existing 420-line selective-trade-policy.js was split byte-identically into trade-policy/context.js (143 lines before the backoff), players.js (48), partners.js (131), and apply.js (123), wired in scripts/build/sources.mjs:42-45.
